# Lapin Motor Co.

> Exotic and luxury vehicle dealer: buy, sell and consign. Two locations, Scottsdale AZ and Portland OR.

Concept note: this file is part of an unofficial Kerblabs design concept. Facts come from lapinmotorco.com. Confirm details and live inventory with the business.

## Locations
- Scottsdale, AZ: 14982 N 83rd Pl, Scottsdale, AZ 85260
- Portland, OR: 8909 SW Barbur Blvd, Portland, OR 97219

## Contact
- Phone: 480-590-4504

## Services
- Buy and sell used exotic and luxury vehicles
- Consignment tailored for high-end automotive vehicles
- Vehicle assessment, valuation and trade-ins
- Transportation
- Financing with a payment calculator
